scenario: [LTIE.4.3]: `publish X` sends X upstream and asserts nothing in the current tier. Tier `edge` publishes Sig(v) for every Trig(v); the integrator bridges it to tier `hub` as [NCBK.10.1] describes -- on DS_EV_ACTION_PUBLISH, the schema name and slot values, asserted on the receiving engine (the harness's `forward` step, [RCTS.1.2.29]). `edge` holds its Trig alone: 1 fact. `hub` holds the forwarded Sig: 1 fact. A runtime that still asserted the published fact locally leaves `edge` at 2; one that raised no ACTION_PUBLISH leaves `hub` empty. Its twin NCBK.10.2_emit_stays_on_its_tier is the same programs with `emit`. PATH: libds's `adapter_ds_publish` / `ds_rete_publish_values` and `bridge_publish`; the Mercury runtime's `ds.exec.publish_verb`.

edge.rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Sig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule up:
    Trig t
->
    publish Sig v: t.v

hub.rules_ds:
schema Sig scope logical:
    v: Int key
